_about: Patch 44: the Brawl soak of 6 Oct (patch 43, game 6, seed 806), Krenko's Goblin Rabblemaster deck. The soak bot had declared some attackers (Cancel reads 'Call Back'), Forge refused ('Attack declaration invalid': Rabblemaster's goblins must attack) and the bot pressed OK again, 28,000 times in 30 minutes (a 1.9 GB record).
